verdict.rationale: Oneleet's own docs say customers can set up and publish a customizable, public Trust Center and link it from their landing page, so the core hosted trust center exists. Nothing in the evidence describes what it contains or how gated sharing works. Missing for 10: live control status display, certification/report listings, click-through NDA gating for report access, any detail on how the trust center speeds up security reviews, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
